## sjulia in Quarto slides

Press **Ctrl+Enter** (or **⌘+Enter**) to execute.

## Hello, sjulia

A minimal print sample.

## Plot a sine curve

A 5-line plotting sample.

```{=html}
<div class="sjulia-executor" data-code="using Plots\nx = 0:0.1:2π\ny = sin.(x)\nplot(x, y)\ntitle!(&quot;sin(x)&quot;)"></div>
```

## Computed value
